text:
QUOTE: With a callback registered, every call not on the allow list still runs. The callback only gets notified.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says a non-allow-listed tool runs only when a callback is registered, and is denied when headless. It also says a tool on neither list is denied by deny-list logic only if it matches deny. It never concludes that the effective posture is default-allow at the blocking gate.
